simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָרָק (H3419) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָרָק (yârâq) means properly, green ; concretely, a vegetable First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 21 2.

definitions.full: H3419. yaraq יָרָק noun [masculine] herbs (collective), herbage (green, greens) — absolute יָרָק Deut 11:10 2 t.; construct יְרַק Isa 37:27 = 2Kin 19:26 ; — גַּןיָֿרָק Deut 11:10 ; 1Kin 21:2 ; יָרָק אֲרֻחַת Prov 15:17 ; as substantive, דֶּשֶׁא יְרַק Isa 37:27 = 2Kin 19:26 green shoots of grass (|| שָׂדֶה עֵשֶׂב , etc.)
